translation_snapshot.source: The target is lost in a nightmare that deals %0.2f darkness damage each turn and has a %d%% chance to cause a random detrimental effect.
translation_snapshot.target: 目标陷入噩梦之中，每回合受到 %0.2f 暗影伤害，并有 %d%% 概率受到一个随机不良效果。

translation_snapshot.source: The gloom has stunned the target, reducing damage by 50%%, putting 4 random talents on cooldown and reducing movement speed by 50%%.  While stunned talents cooldown twice as slow.
translation_snapshot.target: 目标被黑暗光环震慑，伤害降低 50%%，随机 4 个技能进入冷却，移动速度降低 50%%。在震慑时技能冷却所需时间翻倍。

translation_snapshot.source: The target's unnatural body has responded to damage taken.
translation_snapshot.target: 目标的诅咒之体对其所受伤害做出了回应。

translation_snapshot.source: Zone-wide effect: Strong scents fill the air and make you feel drowsy. If the timer reaches 0 you will fall into a dreaming sleep state. -10% mind resistance, -20% sleep resistance, +10% nature damage.
translation_snapshot.target: 区域效果： 强烈的气味充满了空气，让你感觉困倦。倒计时结束时，你将陷入梦境中的沉睡状态。-10% 精神抗性，-20% 睡眠免疫，+10% 自然伤害。
